::: {#def-dbrnffrcistg .theorem}
## DBRNFFRCISTG model

A dyadic bipartite random network finest fully randomized causally interpretable structured tree graph (DBRNFFRCISTG) is a causal model $\mathscr C = (\mathscr M, \mathscr M^{(\Gamma)})$ of a [DBRNNPSEM](#def-dyadic-npsem) $\mathscr M$ that satisfies the conditions of a [BRNFFRCISTG](#def-brnffrcistg), except that [single-world independence](#def-single-world) takes each [dyad](#def-dyad), rather than each row, as a single variable: the one-step-ahead counterfactuals of the dyads are mutually independent, and independent of those of the other variables.

It specializes the BRNFFRCISTG, which specializes the [RNFFRCISTG](#def-rnffrcitg): a person's ties to different places are independent given the past, and each depends on the person, the place and the dyad's own history through bounded summaries.
:::
